chapter: Will Marion Cook and the Southern Syncopated Orchestra
title: Substituting for Cricket at rehearsal; Will Marion Cook's offer
summary: Told to take Cricket's place at a rehearsal, the young Briggs played the sentimental cornet solos, and Will Marion Cook, watching, asked him to join an orchestra to tour.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

And Cricket one Sunday afternoon
during the rehearsal, no one knew that Mr.
Cook would assist this rehearsal.

It so happened, Cricket, he had
tonsillitis or something and at the last minute
he didn't show up.

So he informed, Lt. Simpson informed
that Cricket won't be there.

I don't know for what reason, 'cause
I was the baby of the band, but for some reason
he looked over and he said, 'You, take over.'
I was shivering and everything as you can
imagine, so I said, 'Mister,' I said, 'Lieutenant,
you're making a mistake.'

He said, 'I asked you to take over.'
So, I was shivering and everything, and we had
to play a medley of folk songs. Not very,--
I did not have to play any overtures or anything
but I could have, if it happened. I liked that
much better.
During the medley of folk songs,
there were three sentimental coronet solos where you had to play the way you feel, you know, not just the notes.

We had "Kentucky Home," and "Old Black Joe," and that I loved. And it was during two of the solos that I played after the way Will Marion Cook, who was sitting in the rehearsal. We had several people that took parents, parents and other people would come and listen to the band rehearsing and everything else.
So, after the rehearsal, --said Dad Cook, I will never forget him, he was gray-headed, fine man, he came up and he said, "Son, you got plenty heart."

I said, "Well, I'm scared to death." "I'm scared to death." (Laughter). I was trembling and everything. He said, "No, you played wonderfully well, you had a nice tone, and your feeling just thrilled me."
He said, "Look, you're young." He said, "I'm forming an orchestra to tour the
United States and maybe Europe, we don't know. I wonder, would you be interested?"
